shellCommands.command:
node node_modules/.bin/next start -p 3006 > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &
PID=$!
sleep 2

echo "=== Test 1: lamp EUR ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3006/products/lamp?currency=EUR | grep -o 'Brass lamp.*' | head -c 200
echo ""

echo "=== Test 2: lamp USD (default) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3006/products/lamp | grep -o 'Brass lamp.*' | head -c 200
echo ""

echo "=== Test 3: vase USD ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3006/products/vase?currency=USD | grep -o 'Stone vase.*' | head -c 200
echo ""

echo "=== Test 4: nonexistent ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3006/products/nonexistent

kill $PID || true

node node_modules/.bin/next start -p 3006 > /dev/null 2>&1 &
PID=$!
sleep 2
curl -s http://localhost:3006/products/nonexistent
kill $PID || true

node node_modules/.bin/next start -p 3007 > /tmp/next3.log 2>&1 &
PID=$!
sleep 2

echo "=== Test 1: lamp EUR ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3007/products/lamp?currency=EUR | grep -o 'Signal Shop collection.*' | head -c 300
echo ""

echo "=== Test 2: nonexistent ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3007/products/nonexistent | grep -o 'NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;404.*'
echo ""

kill $PID || true

node node_modules/.bin/next start -p 3007 > /tmp/next3.log 2>&1 &
PID=$!
sleep 2

curl -N -s http://localhost:3007/products/lamp?currency=EUR | grep -E '(div hidden id=|template id=)'

kill $PID || true

npm run build
node node_modules/.bin/next start -p 3008 > /tmp/next_cache_test.log 2>&1 &
PID=$!
sleep 2

curl -s http://localhost:3008/products/lamp?currency=EUR > /dev/null
curl -s http://localhost:3008/products/lamp?currency=EUR > /dev/null

sleep 1
kill $PID || true
rm -f test-cache.js
cat /tmp/next_cache_test.log
